about: Per-piece fastener schedule for the $ inspect hover mode and the takeoff. Code basis: 2024 IRC as adopted in Montana (DLI, effective 2026-09-26), Table R602.3(1) and the sections it points to; manufacturer instructions where the IRC defers. Counts are minimum code/manufacturer counts per installed piece. Purchases add extra_pct for bent/dropped nails. All dollar amounts derived from this file are EXAMPLE.
how_engine_uses_it: reference/takeoff-reference.mjs takeoff(model, rules, prices, { fastenerSchedule }) builds pieces[] from model objects + derived studs, evaluates each connection rule, sums counts per fastener id, and buys the cheapest box mix from fasteners[id].options. purchase:"line" fasteners (anchor bolts, hangers, ties, clips, adhesive, tie wire) are already bought by their own takeoff line; pieces only show their unit price.
unit_price_rule: unitPrice = box price / pack_qty of the box the purchase mix uses most of (bulk price when the line qualifies). Connectors: the each price. Adhesive: tube price / defaults.floor.adhesiveLfPerTube (40 lf). Tie wire: roll price / defaults.rebar.tiesPerRollEstimate (120).

rule_kinds.per_bearing: n per bearing end of the piece
rule_kinds.per_rim_end: n per end that butts a rim
rule_kinds.per_lap: n per lap carried by the piece

sheet_rule: Panel w x l laid with l across supports at support_oc_in. Supports crossed = l/oc + 1; the 2 end supports are panel edges (edge_oc_in), the rest are intermediate (field_oc_in): nails = 2 x (w/edge + 1) + (supports - 2) x (w/field + 1). If long_edges_on_framing (wall sheets, vertical): long edges at edge_oc, plates at edge_oc, studs between at field_oc, corners not double counted. Results for 4x8: wall (studs 16, 6/12) = 62, subfloor (joists 16, 6/12) = 43, roof (rafters 24, 6/6) = 45.
underlayment_rule: courses per plane = ceil(slope length in / (roll_w - side_lap)); lap lines = courses + 1 per plane at lap_oc_in along the eave length; + 1 centerline per course at center_oc_in.

heel_table.note: Table R802.5.2(1), 16d common per heel joint, rafter slope 4:12 only (other slopes: look up and add). Columns = ground snow load psf; values = [12 ft, 24 ft, 36 ft roof span]. Roof span between columns: the next larger column is used (no interpolation assumed). Not required when the ridge is supported by a load-bearing wall, header or ridge beam. Applies to roof live load <= 20 psf; ceiling joists at the bottom of the attic (HC/HR = 0).
heel_table.unknown_snow_flag: Site ground snow load UNVERIFIED - heel nails use the 70 psf column (the table maximum). If the site value is > 70 psf the table does not apply: heel joints must be engineered.

gun_3x131.label: 3-1/4 x 0.131 collated framing nail
gun_3x131.nails_vs_screws: nails (code). Screws only if approved under R104.2.2 / an ICC-ES report for that connection.
gun_3x131.interpretation: The table lists 3 x 0.131; 3-1/4 x 0.131 is the common 21-deg gun nail (same diameter, longer). Generally accepted as meeting the 3 x 0.131 row - confirm with the building official (Montana Building Codes Bureau (406) 841-2056).

common_16d.label: 16d common 3-1/2 x 0.162 hand nail
common_16d.nails_vs_screws: nails (code). Item 10 (built-up header) has no 0.131 gun-nail option; 16d box 3-1/2 x 0.135 @ 12 in each edge is the only other listed option.

common_8d_hdg.label: 8d common 2-1/2 x 0.131 HDG hand nail
common_8d_hdg.nails_vs_screws: nails. For connectors use only the nail size the manufacturer lists (Simpson: 0.131 x 2-1/2 for H2.5A on rafters). Simpson SD connector screws are a manufacturer-listed substitute (PRICE NEEDED, not priced).

roof_sheath_8d.label: 8d common 2-1/2 x 0.131 x 0.281 head (roof sheathing)
roof_sheath_8d.code_size: 8d common 2-1/2 x 0.131 x 0.281 head, or RSRS-01 2-3/8 x 0.113 x 0.281 head
roof_sheath_8d.interpretation: The 2-3/8 x 0.113 ring-shank box in the price list may be RSRS-01 (0.281 head) - if the box says RSRS-01 / ASTM F1667 RSRS-01 you may use it for the roof too and skip this purchase. Gun-nail option: confirm head >= 0.281.

ring_238x113.label: 2-3/8 x 0.113 ring-shank collated nail (deformed, 0.266 head)
ring_238x113.code_size: deformed 2-3/8 x 0.113 x 0.266 head (items 31/32 wall and subfloor)
ring_238x113.nails_vs_screws: nails (code). Subfloor screws are allowed only per the panel/adhesive maker or an approved alternate (R104.2.2).

connector_148x3.label: 0.148 x 3 HDG connector nail (10d common size)
connector_148x3.nails_vs_screws: nails per Simpson; SD9212 screws are a Simpson-listed alternate for LUS (PRICE NEEDED).

roofing_114.label: 1-1/4 in 11 ga EG roofing nail
roofing_114.code_size: R905.2.5: galvanized, >= 12 ga (0.105) shank, >= 3/8 head, ASTM F1667, >= 3/4 in into deck or through it
roofing_114.nails_vs_screws: nails only (staples not allowed for asphalt shingles by R905.2.5 text: "fasteners ... shall be galvanized steel, stainless steel, aluminum or copper roofing nails").

roofing_134.label: 1-3/4 in EG roofing nail (ridge cap)
roofing_134.code_size: same as roofing_114, longer to get 3/4 in into the deck through the ridge layers
roofing_134.interpretation: Length choice is ours, not GAF's: GAF only says "long enough to penetrate 3/4 in into the deck".

cap_1in.code_size: Stinger EXO: 1 in x 0.105 EG ring shank with 1 in cap (HandDrive); Tyvek: Wrap Cap nails or equivalent
